name: [✨Mastery] Arena : Tower Defense [Beta]
desc:
In an apocalypse of Void zombies; Rubies, Amethysts, and all in between must join hands to defend their own people against the horde. These guys are strong. Are you prepared for this?

🛡️ Defend with your friends against all kinds of Void zombies that get stronger overtime!
⚔️ Unlock towers of various classes with unique upgrades and abilities!
🌀 Reveal your tower's strongest form by upgrading it to it's Master Level!
📖 Empower your towers to have better utility with the Mastery!
❓ Explore the secrets of the Hybrid Cafe and it's people?

Get a free food coupon daily with a Roblox Premium Subscription!
